props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first tabbable element on mount. Defaults to true when trapped.

props.name: children
props.type: undefined | null | string | number | bigint | false | true | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: enabled
props.description: Whether the scope is active. Defaults to true.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Element to focus on mount (takes priority over autoFocus).

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Restore focus to previously focused element on unmount.

props.name: trapped
props.description: Trap focus within this scope (for modal overlays).
